jinx.reason: Alch Ability is: If you vote on every nomination and speak like a baffled player during the day, that night you learn a piece of true info.
The Alchemist's announced words might be false.
If the Alchemist-Watcher chooses an evil player, they receive false information.
The Assassin has no ability on Night 4.
If the Armageddon is drunked by the Courtier, the Storyteller chooses which 3 players live on Night 4.
The Devil's Advocate has no ability on Night 4.
The Engineer cannot create an Armageddon after night 4.
The Evil Twin has no ability on Night 4.
On Night 4, the Exorcist learns if they ever chose the Armageddon, even if dead. If the Exorcist chooses the Armageddon, they still wake up.
The Goon has no ability on Night 4.
If the Armageddon is in play and the Grandchild dies by execution, evil wins. The Grandmother has no ability on Night 4.
If the Armageddon is created from the Hatter after Night 4, the Armageddon immediately chooses 3 players.
A protected player might survive instead of you if you are chosen by Armageddon.
If the Armageddon is in play, and at least 1 player is dead, the King learns an alive character each night.
If the Armageddon and Mayor are alive on day 4 & no execution occurs, the Mayor's team wins.
A protected player might survive instead of you if you are chosen by Armageddon.
If the Princess nominates & executes on their first day, the Princess learns an Armageddon is in play.
If an evil player nominates & executes the Soldier, the Soldier's team wins.
The Godfather has no ability on Night 4.
If the Lycanthrope kills a good player, the Arsonist chosen player isn't poisoned.
If the Princess nominates & executes on their first day, the Arsonist must choose a player, but they don't become poisoned.
Players poisoned by the Xaan don't count for the Arsonist's ability.
Any good Minions that has a jinx with Alchemist will have the modified ability the jinx reads.
The Demon can't have the Portia Featherington ability.
The Scarlet Woman will become a Demon if & only if the Gyutaro dies.
The Chambermaid learns if the Informant wakes tonight.
The Informant can learn if the Mathematician wakes tonight.
Each night* the Leviathan chooses an alive good player (different to previous nights): If the Leviathan chooses the Pathologist chosen player, the Pathologist learns a player that's not a Demon.

While the Leviathan is in play, they do not learn the Journalist's picks. Each night, the Leviathan chooses an alive good player (different to previous nights): if the Leviathan chooses a Leviathan chosen player, the Journalist learns a true statement, even if dead.
One additional Townsfolk might become evil.
If the Lolth is summoned, a Townsfolk might become evil.
If the Pit Hag turns an evil player into a Portia F., they cannot turn good due to their own ability.
Each night* the Riot chooses an alive good player (different to previous nights): if the Riot chooses the Pathologist chosen player, the Pathologist learns a Riot is in-play.

While the Riot is in play, they do not learn the Journalist's picks. Each night, the Riot chooses an alive good player (different to previous nights): if the Riot chooses a Journalist chosen player, the Journalist learns a true statement, even if dead.
The Baffled player might register as evil to the Vizier.
The Vizier might not be able to push on a Jester that claimed Jester during their defense.
The Vizier isn't announced if the Secretary saw the Vizier.
